metadata.name: ManageStatementMessages
metadata.description: This API shall be used to manage the statement messages in terms of adding/updating/deleting the message.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: To decide if the API is getting used for Add/Update/Delete. Valid Values: 0 = Add 1= Update 2=Delete Example: 0

request_fields.name: StatementMessage
request_fields.description: StatementMessage

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: StatementMessageGroupCode
request_fields.description: Code of the statement message group which is created to group all the statement messages. Valid Values: Code which is generated with this API at the time of Create or get this via GetStatementMessageGroup API. Example: 100 Condition: This shall be a required field when DecisionFlag=0. It will work with DecisionFlag=0 only. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: StatementMessageTypeCode
request_fields.description: Code associated with the Statement Message Type(activity types). Valid Values: Refer 'Statement Message Types' section of the Appendix sheet. Condition: This shall be a required field when DecisionFlag = 0.It will work with DecisionFlag = 0 only. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: StatementTypeCode
request_fields.description: Code for the Type of Statement where the Statement message should get displayed. Condition: This shall be a required field when DecisionFlag = 0 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: StatementMessageCode
request_fields.description: User defined unique value to identify the Statement Message . Valid Value: A-Z,0-9 Example: ST123 Condition: This shall be a required field when DecisionFlag = 0 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: StatementMessage
request_fields.description: Message displayed in message section of statement at end Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Example: You account is past due Condition: This shall be a required field when DecisionFlag = 0 Allowable Values: 999

request_fields.name: Priority
request_fields.description: To decide which messge to show first on Statement. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10

request_fields.name: CurrentBalance
request_fields.description: Current balance of the account to use as criteria for delivering the statement message. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100.00

request_fields.name: MessagePeriod
request_fields.description: Decides when the message should display on the Statement. Valid Values:Refer Appendix Section 'Statement Message Period) Example: June Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: LastDigitOfAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Last digit of the account number to use as criteria for delivering the statement message. Valid Values: 0,1,2,3….9, All Example: All Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Selection of language Valid Values: en Example: en Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: DataVariable
request_fields.description: Selection of DataVariable Valid Values: 123 Example: 123 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Indicates the state for setting up statement message disclosures. Valid Values: AK,AL,MA Example: AL,MA Allowable Values: 30

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

StatementMessage.StatementMessage: Your promotional offer on purchases will end on <Promo End Date>
